Answer status: 83 verified / 40 unverified; this reflects answer-key review status, not an assertion that the question text is flawless. Import QA 2026-11-19: 22 subject labels corrected; cross-batch source IDs made importer-safe; source-conflicted keys remain unverified. This is a historical question-bank collection, not a claim that the pack count equals the official exam quota. the rest carry their best single-source key or no key, flagged per question. Explanations are null throughout (no cleanly alignable source). The S1 parse of this set is not in paper order (blog fragments scrambled); subject labels are source-attested per question where matched. The book grid validated only for Bangla and English and was used only there. AI-solved keys (2026-11-18, not source-verified): 19. Keyless: 1. QA audit 2026-11-19: see QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md.
